capabilities: Draws every note and link with a raw WebGL2 renderer
Groups tightly linked notes into named constellations
Lays out graphs with force, clustered or radial modes
Pins dragged notes and restores the layout on reopen
Colors nodes by folder, constellation or custom query groups
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; install by hand from release files. Needs Obsidian 1.7.2+ and a WebGL2 device. No network requests or telemetry; writes data.json and layout.json in its own plugin folder.
intentEvidence: By default the core graph's color groups are used.
problem: The built-in graph view can stutter on vaults with thousands of notes.
summary: WebGL2 graph view that renders vault notes as glowing stars with named constellations, live layouts, focus and search.
